verdict.rationale: Superset ships an official CLI (`superset`) documented as a single static binary driving the same backend as the desktop app, used to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the host server from a terminal or CI — directly serving AI-native/agentic workflows (e.g. the `superset:orchestrate` skill drives sub-agents via this CLI). Confirmed live via probe of the docs page. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of the CLI (community evidence focuses on the desktop app/terminal UX, not the standalone CLI binary), and no detailed command reference beyond high-level description.
